items.mainDefect: Background legacy writes inherit request cancellation and can be cancelled when the handler returns.

secondary.defect: Legacy write failures are counted in metrics but never logged.

items.mainDefect: Legacy Update receives the original objInfo instead of the unified-storage result wrapped in updateWrapper, allowing conflicts or divergent updates.

secondary.defect: Legacy update failures or divergence occur without an error log.

items.mainDefect: Unified-storage Create failures are recorded through recordLegacyDuration instead of recordStorageDuration.

secondary.defect: Unified-storage Update failures are recorded through recordLegacyDuration instead of recordStorageDuration.
Successful Delete metrics use the object name instead of options.Kind, creating incorrect labels and unbounded cardinality.
Legacy DeleteCollection duration is recorded through recordStorageDuration instead of recordLegacyDuration.
Delete puts the base logger into the context instead of the enriched logger, losing contextual fields.

items.mainDefect: Legacy.Create receives an object that Storage.Create may already have mutated with unified-storage metadata.

secondary.defect: Sharing the Create object with the background legacy write can race with response serialization.

items.mainDefect: Unified-storage Update failures are recorded through recordLegacyDuration instead of recordStorageDuration.

secondary.defect: Legacy DeleteCollection duration is recorded through recordStorageDuration instead of recordLegacyDuration.

items.mainDefect: Background legacy writes inherit request cancellation and can be cancelled after the response is sent.

secondary.defect: The mode 3 playlist integration tests immediately read legacy storage without waiting for asynchronous writes, making them racy.

items.mainDefect: The unified-storage Create failure test configures its failing expectation on the legacy store instead of the storage store.

secondary.defect: Legacy and storage mocks share one mock.Mock, allowing calls to one store to satisfy expectations intended for the other.

items.mainDefect: Mode 3 unit tests neither wait for nor verify background legacy writes, so removing those writes would leave the tests passing.

secondary.defect: Delete and DeleteCollection tests omit legacy expectations, causing unexpected mock calls in background goroutines.

items.mainDefect: Background legacy writes inherit request cancellation and can be cancelled before completion.

secondary.defect: Legacy write failures are counted in metrics but never logged.
